about_the_game:
Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude contains the first two dungeons and boss fights of the game. All progress carries over to the main game.

Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot.

Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards.

Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might, and confront calamitous bosses. As your heroes fell enemies, your knowledge of monsters grow filling the Beastiary with valuable knowledge making all your heroes more effective in combat! Fight in massive 9-man boss raids utilizing your powerful roster of heroes for glory and loot!

Build your own guild from the ground up, unlock guild upgrades, customize your heroes and guild banner from a wide variety of emblems or your own custom images.

Your success as a guild translates into greater services as you build out the town unlocking more options for your guild like expeditions and a large roster, better resources to exploit, growing from a small village to a bustling city.

Choose from 22 combat and utility skills for a robust free-form and classless skill system including melee, ranged, and magic characters allowing you to specialize your heroes any way you wish. Augment your team with over 25+ abilities like Bonk, Fissure, and Life Steal, using any 5 abilities in any combination you choose.

As you explore Dragaea you will be able to recruit new party members to aid you in your journey forming multiple teams of 3 to explore dungeons and tackle challenges becoming the finest adventuring guild in all the land. You can even unlock expeditions that allow your parties to adventure while the game is off!

The land of Dragaea is a place filled mystery, intrigue, and precious treasure. Collect and upgrade over 200+ pieces of weapons, armor, accessories, items, and other consumables to augment your party's prowess. No two pieces of equipment are the same with different rarities and stats affecting the possibilities. Found a favorite axe or staff? Upgrade it to it's max potential and give your adventurers the finest tools to do the job. A full featured inventory system and shop system lets you manage your collections effortlessly.
